skills/mole.description: Drive the Mole CLI (`mo`) on macOS or Windows: find what uses disk space, preview and run cleanup, uninstall apps, and read system health and cleanup history. Use before running any `mo` command. Not for editing Mole source code.

.claude/skills/bugs.description: Mole incident catalog for cleanup safety, bounded probes, cancellation, dry-run parity, and actionable gates. Use for a Mole safety-sensitive diff; not for docs, release notes, or generic review.

.claude/skills/release-flow.description: Mole CLI release runbook for distribution channels, pre-flight checks, capital-V tags, artifacts, and curated-note handoff. Use when assessing or executing a Mole release. Not for release-note copy alone or ordinary code review.

.claude/skills/release-notes.description: Publish curated release notes for an existing Mole `V<version>` tag, including bilingual format, `gh release edit`, contributor thanks, and reactions. Use only when explicitly asked to edit or publish Mole release notes. Not for release readiness, tagging, or code review.

.claude/skills/weekly-audit.description: Audit both Mole CLI branches for safety, correctness, performance and stale guidance, then land authorized fixes. Use for weekly or whole-CLI reviews. Not for a single defect or individual PR review.
